title: Specify safeguards and governance for identity-linkage decisions
requirements:
- Widen the risk statement beyond deterrence from care to surveillance, function creep, discrimination and non-health access
- Require multisector representation according to actual authority, dependency and risk
- Require purpose limitation and restricted matching across sensitive services
- Distinguish cross-government consultation from health-sector decision authority over health-identity data
- Require a documented policy decision supported by legal, human-rights, privacy, equity and threat assessments
- Provide for independent oversight and periodic review of the linkage model
